title: toilet carpet
text: toilet carpet. I ordered the lemon mist color first.. it is quite yellow... I think lemon mist is a very accurate name.  I was thinking it would be a bit lighter... so... I went back and ordered the beige.  The yarn is a bit shiny - in case that matters to you.. rubber backed to keep it place.  Small.  Machine wash and dried well.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
